title: Adidas Tokyo
meta_description: Adidas Tokyo is a concept film cut into three stripes and released as three separate posts, each a night on the same street.
deck: A concept film cut into three stripes and released as three, so the campaign arrives the way the mark does: one line at a time.

proof.title: Three stripes, three drops.
proof.note: This is not one film chopped into parts. Each stripe is a complete night on the same street, and the three only resolve into a campaign once they have all been posted.

shots.alt: Night street seen from behind a figure in a navy adidas jacket, the trefoil across the back, facing a lit corner building with parked cars.
shots.caption: Stripe 1 / away

shots.alt: The same figure turning back toward the camera on the same street, a plaster on one cheek, the three stripes running down the sleeve.
shots.caption: Stripe 3 / turn

proof.caption: The camera holds one position across the release. Only the figure turns, so three separate posts build a single gesture over a week of feed.

acts.title: Stripes.
acts.note: Numbered like the mark itself, and released out of order on purpose.

items.title: Walk
items.copy: A point-of-view ending on an empty street, shot to feel carried rather than composed.

items.title: Street
items.copy: The city closes in. Neon, parked cars, and nothing else moving.

items.title: Turn
items.copy: The last shoe you will see, and the only moment the face is given.

pipeline.title: Pipeline.
pipeline.note: Boarded in Figma, generated through Higgsfield for continuity, then held to one camera position so the location reads as real.

items.label: Board
items.copy: Three-stripe structure and shot order fixed on one Figma board before generation.

items.label: Generate
items.copy: Higgsfield carrying character and wardrobe continuity across all three nights.

items.label: Compose
items.copy: One camera position held across the set, so the street reads as a place rather than a backdrop.

items.label: Export
items.copy: Vertical masters cut for feed and released as separate posts rather than one film.
